## Summary of Changes
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/motivation.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding ECMAScript or Web API capability)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement / optimization
- [ ] 🧪 Test262 / WPT conformance improvement
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🔧 Refactoring or tooling improvements

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's code style guidelines (`cargo fmt --check`).
- [ ] I have run `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` and addressed all warnings.
- [ ] I have added unit or integration tests verifying my changes (`cargo test --workspace`).
- [ ] If this touches language semantics, I have verified Test262 impact (`cargo run -p doms_cli -- test262`).
- [ ] Relevant documentation has been updated.
